title: 2026 AMC 8 Regional Problems/Problem 20
text:
Out of 6 consecutive odd integers, there can only be 2 multiples of 3, 2 multiples of 5, 1 multiple of 7, and one multiple of 11.

Since there are only 6 in this list, there must be all of the aforementioned traits, and no number can be a multiple of 2 of 3, 5, 7, and 11.

The first and last must be multiples of 5, so the 2nd and 5th must be multiples of 3. The multiples of 7 and 11 are irrelavant to this problem, and can be in any order.

Since the 5th must be a multiple of 3, the 6th must be 2 mod 3. Looking at the options, only 1 is 2 mod 3, being (C) 2.
